overview_description.description:
Founded in 2012 and based in Amman, Jordan, Gweet is a trusted community marketplace for people to list, find, and book unique accommodations around the world online. Whether you want an apartment, a farms, or a villa ,For a night, a week, a month or even a whole year Gweet connects people to unique travel experiences, within your budget,. And with world-class customer service and a growing community of users, Gweet is the easiest way for people to monetize their extra space and showcase it to an audience of millions. Since that Homestay accommodation can provide an attractive and useful addition to the many other forms of accommodation available for visitors to their area so they committed to theirselves to value their customers and provide them with exceptional service by their professional agents who're specialized in renting houses and also they can offer their services in English and Arabic. 

GWEET offers you so much more than ordinary travel, where you observe a place and its people from a distance. It’s an unmissable opportunity to see beyond the usual tourist trail. To not just see the country, but to experience it as it’s meant to be experienced.
